pr_title: Fix test debris from trustedroot integration tests
pr_body:
<!--
  Thank you for contributing to GitHub CLI!
  To reference an open issue, please write this in your description: `Fixes #NUMBER`
-->

The trustedroot integration tests were leaving TUF repository cache files in the working directory. This PR fixes the issue by:

* Adding a temporary directory mechanism for TUF cache during tests
* Using a shared testCacheDir variable to manage the temp directory
* Creating temp directories only during test runs (when GO_INTEGRATION_TEST=1)
* Adding a CleanupTestCache function to properly remove the temp directory
* Updating tests to use proper cleanup through deferred functions
* The changes ensure that no debris files are left behind after running the tests.

Fixes: #10462

Created with [Solver](https://solverai.com/)

issue_context.title: Running `github.com/cli/cli/v2/pkg/cmd/attestation/trustedroot` tests leaves debris
issue_context.body:
## Description

Running the trusted root tests leaves debris in the local working directories.

```
➜  go test -tags=integration ./pkg/cmd/attestation/trustedroot -count 1

ok      github.com/cli/cli/v2/pkg/cmd/attestation/trustedroot   0.337s

➜ ✗ git status
On branch 9897-gh-cache-delete-exit-code
Untracked files:
  (use "git add <file>..." to include in what will be committed)
        pkg/cmd/attestation/verification/tuf-repo-cdn.sigstore.dev.json
        pkg/cmd/attestation/verification/tuf-repo.github.com.json

nothing added to commit but untracked files present (use "git add" to track)
```

### Expected Output

The expected output for this work is:
 * These tests do not leave debris in the current directory, preferably by ensuring these files go to tmp and are cleaned up after run
